page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmg7a.64xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance featuring 256 dedicated vCPUs and 1024.0 GB of system memory. Operating on the KVM hypervisor, this instance allocates a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core, aligning with standard general-purpose resource ratios at an extremely large scale.

The instance does not include any bundled local storage, requiring external block storage solutions for data persistence. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included with this configuration.

Given its massive physical resource footprint, the ecs.ebmg7a.64xlarge offers high resource density for enterprise workloads. The qualitative cost efficiency is centered on consolidating multiple smaller workloads or running highly parallelized applications that benefit from dedicated CPU allocation without virtualization overhead. Best-fit workloads include large-scale web serving, enterprise databases, container orchestration nodes, and parallel processing tasks that do not require local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration.
